MASTER SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT

This Master Subscription Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into between Stratus Cloud Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Provider"), and the customer identified in the Order Form ("Customer").

1. Services and Subscription
1.1 Provider will make the Services available to Customer during the Subscription Term in accordance with the Documentation and the Order Form.
1.2 Customer shall comply with the Acceptable Use Policy available at https://stratus.example.com/aup, as updated by Provider from time to time.

2. Fees and Payment
2.1 Customer shall pay all fees within fifteen (15) days of the invoice date. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month.
2.2 Provider may increase the fees at any time upon notice to Customer.

3. Term and Renewal
3.1 The initial Subscription Term is twelve (12) months. The Agreement shall automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term.
3.2 Provider may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time on thirty (30) days notice.

4. Service Levels
Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to make the Services available 99.5% of the time. Service credits as described in the SLA are Customer's sole and exclusive remedy for any unavailability.

5. Customer Data
5.1 Customer owns all Customer Data. Provider shall implement reasonable security measures to protect Customer Data.
5.2 Provider may use Customer Data and usage data to improve the Services and to train its machine learning models.
5.3 Provider will notify Customer of a security incident affecting Customer Data within seven (7) days.

6. Warranties
THE SERVICES ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" AND PROVIDER DISCLAIMS ALL WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED.

7. Indemnification
Customer shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Provider from any and all claims, losses and expenses arising out of or relating to Customer's use of the Services.

8. Limitation of Liability
IN NO EVENT SHALL PROVIDER'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY EXCEED THE FEES PAID BY CUSTOMER IN THE THREE (3) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM. PROVIDER SHALL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES.

9. General
9.1 Provider may audit Customer's use of the Services upon notice to verify compliance with this Agreement.
9.2 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California and the courts of San Francisco County shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
9.3 The Data Processing Addendum in Exhibit B is incorporated herein by reference.
